data.standardized_narrative: The report does not present a clear, explicit gross prior-year reserve movement figure. The gross claims outstanding at the prior year-end (31 December 2013) has been read from the Balance Sheet liabilities comparative column as approximately GBP 76.621m. No unequivocal 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure or gross claims development triangle could be located in the scanned pages available; therefore no quantified prior-year strengthening/release amount is reported.
data.data_quality_notes: Documents are scanned/rotated images. The Balance Sheet liability line 'Claims outstanding' was read visually from the comparative (2013) column and interpreted as ~GBP 76.621m (thousands converted to millions). The report pages available did not clearly present a labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure or an unambiguous gross claims development triangle. Some numbers (especially assets/reinsurer's share lines) were difficult to read; therefore prior-year development is reported as null rather than risking an incorrect extraction. Use caution: figures were transcribed from a low-resolution scanned PDF.
